from pocket_coffea.utils.configurator import Configurator
from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_functions import get_HLTsel, get_nObj_min, get_nBtagMin
from pocket_coffea.parameters import defaults

import os
localdir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))

default_parameters = defaults.get_default_parameters()
parameters = defaults.merge_parameters_from_files(
    default_parameters,
    f"{localdir}/params/object_preselection.yaml",
    f"{localdir}/params/triggers.yaml",
    update=True,
)

# HLT trigger selection for the semileptonic primary dataset
HLT_semileptonic = get_HLTsel(primaryDatasets=["semileptonic"])

# At least 4 JetGood jets with pT > 30 GeV
at_least_4_jets_pt30 = get_nObj_min(4, minpt=30, coll="JetGood")

# At least 2 b-tagged jets
at_least_2_btags = get_nBtagMin(2, coll="BJetGood")

skim = [
    HLT_semileptonic,
    at_least_4_jets_pt30,
]

preselections = [
    at_least_4_jets_pt30,
    at_least_2_btags,
]

cfg = Configurator(
    parameters=parameters,
    datasets={
        "jsons": [f"{localdir}/datasets/ttHTobb_local.json"],
        "filter": {
            "samples": ["ttHTobb"],
            "samples_exclude": [],
            "year": ["2018"],
        },
    },
    workflow=None,
    skim=skim,
    preselections=preselections,
    categories={
        "baseline": preselections,
    },
    weights={
        "common": {
            "inclusive": ["genWeight", "lumi", "XS", "pileup"],
            "bycategory": {},
        },
        "bycategory": {},
        "bysample": {},
    },
    variations={
        "weights": {
            "common": {"inclusive": [], "bycategory": {}},
            "bysample": {},
            "bycategory": {},
        },
    },
    variables={},
    columns={},
)
